messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm opening a PR to refresh the Quickstart 'Hello Garden' onboarding flow: consolidate auth snippets, add a one-click deploy section, and replace deprecated SDK calls. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 Please help with link checks and sample app deploy. cc @alex @jin @sam

alex: Nice — can you paste the SDK change? I can update TS/JS snippets.

maria: old: `client.generate({model:'rw1',prompt})` new: `client.text.generate({model: 'rw1', input: prompt})` Also switching examples from SDKv4 -> SDKv5's named params.

alex: Got it. I'll run a quick grep for `generate(` and `client.generate` and open a follow-up PR for the JS snippets.

jin: Docker note: the Dockerfile in the sample app still uses `python:3.9` and `pip install -r requirements.txt`. We should pin 3.11 and add `--no-cache-dir` to pip. Small patch incoming.

sam: Checklist from my side:
- run quickstart end-to-end in staging
- verify auth instructions (token env var naming)
- update link to new CLI flags
- add one-liner migration note for enterprises

maria: token env var currently `REDWOOD_API_KEY` — should we standardize on `REDWOOD_KEY`? Thoughts?

alex: prefer `REDWOOD_API_KEY` keeps explicit. Docs should mention both if we change, maybe add migration note.

jin: staging run found one failing test: sampleapp/api/handlers/deploy.py uses `os.getenv('REDWOOD_API')` — inconsistent. I'll change to `REDWOOD_API_KEY` in PR.

devex-bot: GitHub PR opened by maria: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 — draft, awaiting reviewers :github: 

sam: I'm free to test this afternoon (2pm PT). Can we get the PR out of draft by 1:30 so I can do an end-to-end deploy?

maria: tagging reviewers now. @alex can you pick up JS snippets? @jin please land Docker & env fixes. I'll convert PR out of draft before 1:15. Thanks :sparkles:

alex: LGTM for snippet plan. I'll aim to push changes by noon.

jin: Docker fix pushed, CI passing. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/847

maria: Awesome. Once sam finishes staging smoke I'll merge. Thanks team :heart:

sam: staging smoke ✅ — deploy succeeded, auth flow works, quickstart tutorial verified. No broken links found.

maria: Merged. Will follow up with a changelog note and a redirect for the old quickstart URL. Closing thread.
